lines: Taimanin... ye are no more than lowly humans...
The pale succubus recited some kind of incantation softly as she collapsed to the floor.
As she didーthe area suddenly began to shake, and it soon turned into an earthquake so strong that it was difficult to stand.
The natural rock walls were falling apart and loose earth was raining down from the ceiling.
The exit is right over there! Run...!!!
Huaaah...!! We made iiiit!!!! ...But where the hell are we!?
After desperately running out of the cave, we were back in the overgrown castle ruins, which looked the same as they had a few days ago.
Looks like everyone made it out in one piece...
There was no trace of the castle, and just a stone monument and a signboard stood there peacefully.
That means almost all of this was an illusion... But it's still hard to tell what was an illusion and what was reality.
The cave has been completely blocked... I wonder what those demons were doing in there.
In the end, the ghost woman that Shikanosuke said he saw never showed up, and whatever those demons were doing here got hidden under all this rubble.
Somehow that's not a very satisfying ending...
And after all those horrors I went through...
We slumped our shoulders in disappointment as we stood amidst the scenery of the mountain and the quietly flowing stream.
For now we've defeated the demons. I'm sure the headmistress will look into the rest. Anyway, let's go home.
Y-Yeah, at least we're all safe...
Wait, ah... aaah! We have a quiz tomorrow... Oh man, I haven't studied at all... L-Let's head home quickly, Fuma! Hebiko!
If you studied properly on a regular basis you would have nothing to worry about.
Ueeeeehh... out of the frying pan and into the fire...
You guys are hopeless, huh. Hebiko will teach you the parts that are likely to show up just this once!
H-Hebiko! You're a goddess, no, an octopus goddess!
Eventually the light rain also stopped and we headed down the moonlit mountain path.
Meanwhile. In the forest a few kilometers from the castle ruinsー
A man looked up at the moon between the clouds, pausing for a moment.
A lump of earth that had risen from the ground quickly took the shape of a man, turning into Gonza, who knelt before his master.
The Gate to the Devildom beneath the castle ruins was decrepit and unusable... It must have been closed for hundreds of years.
Hm, I see. Nomad's information is surprisingly worthless.
Gaiza replied casually. He had thought that this might be the case from the beginning.
It was said that the lord of the castle once made demons and monsters his followers and ruled his people with fearー
But one day, his rule came to an abrupt end. The lord of the castle had lost his power and was easily defeated by the people he had oppressed.
If the old stories were true, then those demons and monsters had been summoned from a Gate to the Devildom.
And the moment he had suddenly lost his strength, was, in other words, the moment when the Gate to the Devildom had lost its powerー
It's always the humans who are the fools, isn't it?
There was already someone examining the decrepit gate when we arrived, and I've lost quite a few of my men. My deepest apologies.
Oh? It was a difficult battle even with you there?
...There was a skilled female warrior accompanied by a mysterious demon.
I thought the demons were all united under Nomad, but I guess they aren't a monolith.
That alone is a useful piece of information, Gonza.
Gonza remained on his knees and watched Gaiza speak those words before disappearing into the forest.
